This home offers a living room and a family room which is hard to find. The family room features a wood-burning fireplace and carpet flooring. The rest of the home has hardwood floors. Screened-in back porch. Fenced-in backyard. 1 car garage. Central Air.
Pet friendly.
A washer and dryer can be added for an additional $30/month.

Excellent location between Prospect and Neil and south of Kirby Avenue. Just a short drive to UIUC and Research park. Within walking distance of Bottenfield Elementary School (top-rated school in Champaign), Art Mart, Harvest Market, Hessel Park, Mattis Park, and restaurants such as Jarling’s Custard, Starbucks, Moe’s, and Wendy’s. Biking trail/walking path around a pond in the back of the neighborhood.

description:

Well maintained 3 bedroom home situated in an established neighborhood. The light and airy living room welcomes you with hardwood flooring. Beautiful and spacious fenced-in backyard with mature trees and plants.

This is one of our most affordable homes in this neighborhood because it doesn’t have central air. The home has 3 window air conditioners and we have never had any complaints of being too hot in the summer.  If you are on a budget and central air is not a must, come and see this home!

Convenient to Bottenfield grade school, Hessel Park, and bus line. Just 5 minute drive to the U of I campus.
